title: calibrate-hardware input
description: One calibration request. The microbenchmark code belongs to the evaluator; this picks a suite and a protocol.

suite.description: Suite name registered inside the evaluator, e.g. core or quick.

quick.description: Fast pass: fewer samples per microbenchmark, for a smoke test.

measured_file.description: Replay a stored calibration report instead of running the suite; used by the regression cases.

previous_file.description: A previously measured file, so a replay can compare against history.

dry_run.description: Derive and compare without writing the measured file.
